name: Ciragan Palace Hotel Kempinski
positioning: Çırağan Palace Kempinski Istanbul, a hotel in a historical palace building and a modern hotel building on the Bosphorus
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in a historical palace building with suites styled after Istanbul's palaces
Guests who like butler-led touches such as the soap service and complimentary suite treats

facts.text: The Palace Suites are located in the historical palace building and offer privacy for palace suite guests.
Apart from the Sultan Suite, the Palace Suites are maisonette-style duplex suites.
The lobby has large windows with a view of the Bosphorus Strait.
In the soap service the butler slices the soap for guests, giving one bar for immediate use and one wrapped in a pouch to take home.
Palace Suite guests can enjoy complimentary amenities such as homemade baklavas and chocolates, Turkish delights, fresh fruits and nuts.
Every guest is welcomed by the Lady in Red, a host dressed in red with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.
The hotel offers a guided history tour of the palace, narrated by a licensed professional tour guide.
The Concierge team arranges private transfers to and from Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport.

highlights.text: Custom-made furniture in the Palace Suites was inspired by Topkapi Palace, Dolmabahce Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and Yildiz Palace.
The Sultan Suite in the historical palace has large sash windows, high ceilings and views of the Bosphorus, the historical peninsula, the palace courtyard or the park.
Palace Suite guests receive handmade 100% pure olive oil soap in four scents: mint-lemon-green tea, jasmine, orange flower and rose-lavender.
The hotel is in two buildings, a historical building and a modern hotel building, with a long Bosphorus shore between them; butlers provide a regular complimentary buggy transfer between the two.
The redesigned lobby has a high ceiling with a Murano-style grand chandelier and locally produced tile art.

considerations.text: Istanbul Airport is around 45 kilometers (28 miles) from the hotel, and Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 50 kilometers (31 miles).
The hotel is split between a historical building and a modern hotel building, with a long Bosphorus shore between them.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive palace setting.
